title: Migrate merge, pr-open, deploy-release to contract v2
goal: Migrate plugins/tool/{merge,pr-open,deploy-release} to contract v2: result_contract:2 in manifest provides, mandatory verdict/disposition/reason in every result write, rc ∈ {0,1}, valid_verdicts enumerated, provides.role and provides.events declared where allowed, no hardcoded declared-input artifact paths in plugin code.

steps.description: Write v2 result tests for merge (TDD red step). Assert result_contract=2, verdict, disposition, reason in merge-result.json on every exit path: pass (squash-merge success), pass with data.mode=pr_fallback (gate absent/fail, review absent), error+broken on branch-is-main, error+broken on checkout failure, error+broken on push reconcile failure, error+broken on gh pr create failure, error+unavailable on gh pr merge failure (outcome unknown), interrupted on rc=130/143/124 from any gh call. Also assert valid_verdicts covers all emitted verdicts. Tests must FAIL before step-3 is implemented.

Update plugins/tool/merge/manifest.yaml: add a full provides: section with result_contract: 2, role: merge_executor, and events: [plugin.result]. Update valid_verdicts from [] to [pass, error]. No router: block — T0 tool, no LLM calls.

Migrate plugins/tool/merge/plugin.sh to contract v2. (a) Every jq result write gains result_contract:2, verdict (pass for merged/pr_fallback, error for failures), disposition (complete, interrupted for rc 130/143/124, unavailable for post-gh-pr-merge interruption, broken for other errors), reason; plugin-specific fields (pr_url, pr_number, branch, issue, mode) move under data:. (b) All return 2 → return 1 at 6 sites (lines ~39, ~113, ~137, ~149, ~174, ~189). (c) Interruption detection: wrap each gh call to capture rc; classify 130/143/124 as interrupted; for gh pr merge specifically, if interrupted then disposition=unavailable (merge may have run). (d) For declared input gate_aggregator_result: replace hardcoded $artifacts_dir/gate-aggregator-result.json with ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS jq read plus artifacts_dir fallback. Tests from step-1 turn green.

Write v2 result tests for pr-open (TDD red step). Assert result_contract=2, verdict, disposition, reason in pr-result.json on every exit path: pass+complete (PR opened), pass+complete (PR updated — existing PR), blocked+complete (review verdict=block), blocked+complete (no review signal — fail-closed), error+broken on branch-is-main, error+broken on push failure, error+broken on no_committed_changes, error+broken on gh pr edit failure, error+broken on gh pr create failure, error+unavailable when gh pr create was interrupted (PR may have been created), interrupted on rc=130/143/124. Tests must FAIL before step-6 is implemented.

Update plugins/tool/pr-open/manifest.yaml: add result_contract: 2 to the existing provides: section. Update valid_verdicts from [] to [pass, blocked, error]. Do NOT add a role — the manifest comment explicitly prohibits it ('Do not give it a role; pr-delivery provides role: pr').

Migrate plugins/tool/pr-open/plugin.sh to contract v2. (a) Every jq result write gains result_contract:2, verdict (pass for opened/updated, blocked for review-block/no-signal, error for failures), disposition (complete, interrupted, broken, unavailable as appropriate), reason; fields status/draft/branch/issue move under data:. (b) All return 2 → return 1. (c) Interruption detection for gh pr create, gh pr edit calls; if gh pr create is interrupted, disposition=unavailable (PR may have been created). (d) For declared input review_report: replace hardcoded $artifacts_dir/review-report.json with ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS jq read plus artifacts_dir fallback. Keep $artifacts_dir/review.json as BY PATH read (undeclared legacy). Tests from step-4 turn green.

Write v2 result tests for deploy-release (TDD red step). Assert result_contract=2, verdict, disposition, reason in deploy-result.json on every exit path: deployed+complete (dry_run), deployed+complete (real tag+push success), error+broken on git tag failure, error+broken on state_file absent, error+broken on git push failure (local tag rolled back), interrupted on rc=130/143/124 from git tag, unavailable if git push was interrupted (tag may already be on remote, local rollback insufficient). Tests must FAIL before step-9 is implemented.

Update plugins/tool/deploy-release/manifest.yaml: add result_contract: 2 to the existing provides: section. valid_verdicts [deployed, error] is already correct — no change. role and events are already declared — no change.

Migrate plugins/tool/deploy-release/plugin.sh to contract v2. (a) All jq result writes gain result_contract:2, disposition (complete for dry_run and success, broken for git tag/push failures, interrupted for rc=130/143/124 on git tag, unavailable for interrupted git push), reason; verdict already present on most paths (verify all paths have it including state_file absent path); plugin-specific fields (tag, pr_url, mode) move under data:. (b) The one return 2 (state_file absent, line ~29) → return 1. (c) Interruption detection: git tag rc=130/143/124 → disposition=interrupted; git push interrupted → disposition=unavailable (tag may have reached remote). (d) For declared input pr_url: replace hardcoded $artifacts_dir/pr-url.txt with ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS jq read plus artifacts_dir fallback. Tests from step-7 turn green.

Update existing tests that assert v1 result shapes for these three plugins, then run the full test suite. pr-open-zero-commits-halts-test.sh asserts rc=2 and event verdict=error — update to expect rc=1 and also assert result_contract=2 and verdict=error in pr-result.json. pr-open-advisory-review-test.sh asserts pr-result.json status field — update assertions to expect v2 fields (result_contract, verdict, disposition). template-merge-policy-test.sh: inspect whether it asserts merge-result.json shape and update if so. Run `npm test`; all new tests from steps 1, 4, 7 must be green.

notes:
PRIMARY OUTPUTS: All three manifests already declare primary: true on their main output (merge_result, pr_url, deploy_result). No step needed to add primary declarations — acceptance criterion satisfied as-is.

ROUTER BUDGETS: All three are T0 tools with no LLM calls. Reference v2 manifests (mutation-gate) carry no router: block. This plan omits router: for all three; requirement is satisfied by absence when tier=T0.

CLEANUP (#1829): All three plugin.sh files have empty cleanup function bodies. Per the issue, if the plugin has nothing to free, the hook is absent from the manifest and that is recorded. Cleanup hooks are absent from all three manifests — the correct declaration per the issue spec.

NO ARTIFACT PATHS IN CODE: The acceptance criterion reads 'the plugin constructs no artifact paths in code — assert by grep over its plugin.sh'. This plan replaces declared-input path constructions (gate-aggregator-result.json, review-report.json, pr-url.txt) with ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS jq reads plus an artifacts_dir fallback. The fallback is necessary for library-call mode: pr-delivery sources merge.sh and pr-open.sh directly without going through lifecycle.sh dispatch, so ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS is not set in that call path. If the acceptance grep must produce ZERO matches even for the literal filenames, pr-delivery would need to set ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS before sourcing — that is out of this issue's scope. This plan matches the ADR-055/#1825 intent: the declared-input id drives resolution, not a hardcoded path construct in plugin code. Legacy BY PATH reads (review.json in both merge and pr-open) are not declared inputs and are exempted per the manifest comments (issue #979).

MERGE rc=2 SITES: Confirmed 6 sites in plugin.sh (lines ~39, ~113, ~137, ~149, ~174, ~189). All become return 1.

PR-OPEN ROLE CONSTRAINT: The manifest comment explicitly prohibits adding a role to pr-open ('Do not give it a role'). valid_verdicts changing from [] to [pass, blocked, error] adds 'blocked' as a new verdict — 'blocked' reflects a terminal decision by this plugin (review verdict=block, no review signal) and should be treated as pass-like by the engine (no retry, no re-open), not as an error.

DEPLOY-RELEASE INTERRUPTION: git tag rc=130/143/124 → interrupted (tag was not applied); git push interrupted → unavailable (tag may be on remote, local rollback of annotation tag does not undo a remote push). The dry_run path has no external calls; disposition=complete.

ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS FORMAT: Assumed to be a JSON object (or env var set to a JSON string) where input ids map to resolved file paths — consistent with lifecycle.sh v2 dispatch and how other v2 plugins (mutation-gate) read their inputs. If the format differs, step-3/6/9 must adapt, noted as an assumption.

MERGE WRITES pr-result.json: merge's _merge_run_inner also writes pr-result.json (for pr-delivery manifest compat). That write must also gain result_contract:2 and v2 fields — included in step-3's scope.

EXISTING TEST REGRESSIONS: pr-open-zero-commits-halts-test.sh expects return 2 (line not read but inferred from comment 'rc=2'). That must change to return 1. pr-open-advisory-review-test.sh uses 'status' field assertions — must change to 'verdict'. template-merge-policy-test.sh likely tests merge policy routing, not result JSON shape — examine before editing.
